Results.ReviewText:
Great grill.  Easily hits high temps >550°.  Also like the broad grill marks-and less falls through grates.
Only detail to modify for next model,  the 4x9 drip pan is easily removed, but the under-burner drip tray is a tight fit.  I like to line the drip tray with aluminum foil but the clearances are too snug for the foil (tends to roll up) and door cramps tray removal.

Results.ReviewText: This grill has been amazing so far. Heats up super quick and holds temp very well. The grill marks are insane. Definitely well worth the money. Setup was also fairly painless. I just wish that it came with a cover.

I've very happy with my purchase and I can see this grill being around for a very long time. Also, the tank gauge is very nice. I love being able to see the approximation of how much propane I have left.

Results.Title: Spirit E-310 Grill

Results.Title: Spirit E-310

Results.ReviewText: The actual grill is great. We love cooking on it.  The reason for only 4 stars is that it arrived with a dented door.  Customer service was great and I got the replacement part fast. Only I got an axle for a different grill.  I called customer service again and they responded very quickly.  I got a replacement door...that was dented on the hinge side of the door instead of the top.  This time I took pictures and sent it to customer service online.  I haven't heard anything from them since then and still have a door compartment that won't close on my brand new grill.  I've always had a weber gill.  The grill works wonderfully, but it seems what "holds" the grill and the shelves are flimsier than how sturdy my weber grills have been in the past.
Results.Title: Great Grill Flimsy Stand

Results.ReviewText:
Great overall grill for the price! If you have the money, I would highly recommend getting the version with the searing burner if you want great color on your meat quickly. 

Pros: Weber quality! Quick assembly with zero issues. Grill seems very sturdy and holds at a constant temperature easily, making it great for long grilling sessions. The cabinet below provides ample storage space for grilling utensils. Easy access to the drip tray for quick cleaning. 

Cons: You need to find the sweet spot for a great sear on meat, and after a month with the grill I'm still searching for the best spot. The propane tank volume device is inaccurate. After it reached the "empty" mark, I've been able to grill for 5 hours so far (and still going!) The hooks on the side trays only hold things on a string, so most grilling tools don't fit and must be stored below grill or somewhere else. 

Hope to have this grill for 10+ years or until I upgrade to the Genesis series.
Results.Title: Great grill to get your feet wet with Weber grills

Results.ReviewText:
This replaced my 20 year old Weber Silver C.  The 310 has good, controllable heat with multiple zones.  Placing the tank on the interior is awkward and a strain on the back in the process.

The Silver C was superior in a couple of ways and I wish Weber had continued the design - 1)  The left side has a hard plastic, with a fold out additional support instead of the stamped stainless steel that discolors.  2)  The tank hangar was on the outside and *much* easier to replace a tank rather than the interior mount it now has.
Results.Title: Good grill, but the 20 year old Weber was better

Results.ReviewText: So far so good. We have used the grill a half dozen times and are very satisfied so far.

Being in quarantine I’m grilling most of my food now!!! The grill is so easy to operate and to clean

Results.ReviewText: I was enjoying this grill quite a bit for the first 3 years I had it. Unfortunately, I went to use it a month ago and the ignition knob froze up and snapped off! I have tried contacting customer service multiple times online and by phone to no avail. Needless to say I am extremely disappointed in the quality of the grill despite always keeping it covered when not in use, and even more so by a complete lack of customer service. All I ask is some kind of response to remedy this situation. When you spend several hundred dollars on a grill you expect a bit more.
Results.Title: Works great until the ignition knob snaps off

Results.ReviewText: The grill is nice, but not as nice as the Weber Genesis Gold that I had to give up due to the size.  I get occasional flare up cooking items that did not flare up on the Genesis grill.  When I open the top to tend to what is cooking, the deeper lid gets hotter near the handle than the old grill.  I am short, so my reach tends to extend a bit more over the grill than the previous design on my earlier Weber Genesis.
Results.Title: NIce grill, but a step down from the Genesis

Results.ReviewText: We have had at least 6 other brands.  We finally bought a Weber grill and I am thrilled that we did.  No more uneven heating, starts up very easily and it’s amazing what we now can cook on our grill.  To us there is nothing better than the taste of grilled food.  Weber has outdone them selves and lives up to their brand name.
Results.Title: Weber is THE best!!

I like the app and the grilling advice provided as well.

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill super east to use and very efficient. I also recently needed a replacement part and the company sent it with no hassle at all. Customer service at its best!! I will forever be a Weber customer.

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
